warning_source: State Comptroller Matanyahu Englman / Office of the State Comptroller
recipient: National Security Council; IDF; Defense Ministry; PM/Defense Minister named as decision owners for cabinet follow-up
warning_summary: Official audit warned that the West Bank seam-barrier defense had materially degraded: 48% of the fence was nonfunctional at end-2021, large-scale crossings could occur without alert, force levels had fallen, surveillance/observer coverage was incomplete, and operational response was inconsistent. It called for an NSC-led comprehensive multi-year barrier/defense plan and PM/DM cabinet approval.
evidence_state: Official primary contemporaneous State Comptroller report published 28 Feb 2023; audited NSC/IDF/MoD and explicitly assigned follow-up to NSC and PM/DM cabinet chain. Same-day N12 independently reported the findings and IDF rebuttal. Published to Notion as WARN-146 / High confidence.
gaps: Scope is West Bank seam barrier, not Gaza and not an Oct-7 prediction. Much underlying condition data are 2021-2022; IDF said the audit did not represent the then-current reality after corrective action. No distinct post-publication implementation decision recovered; response remains Unclear.

warning_source: Israeli Foreign Ministry Center for Political Research (Mamad/CPR)
recipient: Relevant political/intelligence bodies; exact named recipients unresolved
warning_summary: Former CPR heads say 2023 products warned Hamas was not deterred, that Palestinian destabilization could produce confrontation including Gaza, and on 19 Sep warned of intensifying Gaza-border unrest.
evidence_state: Retrospective Ynet investigation cites former CPR heads; official MFA material independently confirms CPR is an intelligence-community assessment body that briefs decision-makers and presents annual assessments to the security cabinet.
gaps: Underlying 2023 assessments, distribution lists and named recipient records remain unrecovered. Do not accept separate Jan/Mar/Sep events until contemporaneous documents or independently corroborated delivery evidence are obtained.

warning_source: Brig. Gen. Amit Saar / IDF Military Intelligence Research Division
recipient: Aharon Haliva and Herzi Halevi; intended for PM/cabinet but not sent before attack
warning_summary: Urgent strategic warning drafted immediately before Oct. 7 about an opportunity perceived by Iran, Hezbollah and Hamas and potential attack/escalation.
evidence_state: Later testimony/reporting says the warning reached the MI chief and chief of staff and was approved for forwarding, but did not reach Netanyahu/cabinet before the attack.
gaps: Original contemporaneous draft/transmission metadata still not recovered. Do not count as a government warning unless delivery before Oct. 7 to a qualifying government recipient is established.

warning_source: Col. Haim Cohen / Northern Gaza Brigade commander
recipient: Southern Command / IDF chain; qualifying government receipt unestablished
warning_summary: Cohen later said the sector had been hot for roughly six weeks before Oct. 7 and that he proposed an opening/preemptive strike up the chain.
evidence_state: Retrospective farewell-speech reporting exists; people around Southern Command chief Yaron Finkelman dispute Cohen's characterization. No contemporaneous order, briefing, message or independent delivery evidence recovered in this pass.
gaps: Remain unresolved; do not accept a post-event 'I warned them' claim without contemporaneous or independent corroboration and a qualifying recipient chain.
